facts.fact: Proparco (France, AFD Group) committed an estimated USD 1 million of equity to ANKA, an Ivorian e-commerce SaaS platform, in its USD 5 million pre-Series A extension round; the document gives the date as 2023 only (published date used for the year).
IFC (World Bank Group) led ANKA's USD 5 million pre-Series A extension round in 2023 with USD 3.4 million, alongside Proparco and Bpifrance; the document gives the date as 2023 only.
